# NOTICE — Content Provenance and Attribution

## IREB AI4RE Prompt Guide

This repository systematically transfers the recommendations and prompt templates of the
**IREB AI4RE Prompt Guide** ("AI4RE — Prompting Guide for AI-supported Requirements
Engineering") into reusable Claude Skills.

- Publisher: IREB e.V. — International Requirements Engineering Board,
  Special Interest Group #AIREB
- Source: <https://ireb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/airebpromptguide/overview>
- Authors credited by IREB: Gunnar Harde, Nikola Kostov, Daniela Kreiner, Christian
  Ploninger, Patrick Steiger, Ellen Volkert, Jonas Walter, Miriam Waßmann, Adil Yilmaz
- The guide "is intended for personal use, inspiration, and discussion, not as a
  definitive standard" (IREB). This repository follows that spirit: it is an independent,
  unofficial transfer of the guide into the Claude Skills format and is **not endorsed by
  or affiliated with IREB e.V.**

All content derived from the guide is marked `[AI4RE]` or `[AI4RE-adapted]` in place and
remains the intellectual property of IREB e.V. and the respective authors.

## Supplementary standards

Content marked `[Supplementary: <source>]` references, among others:

- IREB CPRE Glossary and quality criteria (IREB e.V.)
- ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2018 — Requirements engineering processes
- INVEST criteria (Bill Wake), SMART criteria
- EARS — Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax (Mavin et al.)
- SOPHIST requirement templates (SOPHIST GmbH)

These references are descriptive; no normative text of the standards is reproduced.

## Marking convention

| Tag | Meaning |
|-----|---------|
| `[AI4RE]` | Taken from the IREB AI4RE Prompt Guide (formatting adapted only) |
| `[AI4RE-adapted]` | Based on the guide, restructured or extended for skill use |
| `[Supplementary: <source>]` | Not from the guide; source named |
| `[Supplementary: this repository]` | Original content of this project (e.g. orchestration) |
